info.name: Common Room Core Activities Prospector Contacts API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of contacts to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of additional columns to include in the response.
Valid column values: `avatarUrl`, `companyName`, `companyWebsite`, `fullName`,
`linkedInFollowerCount`, `linkedInHandle`, `location`, `role`, `seniority`,
`skills`, `title`. The meta column `recordCount` can be requested to return
the total number of matching contacts in `meta.recordCount`.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of prospector-discovered contacts.
